title: Earnings-Volume Discount on Payout Methods Transfer Fees: Questions Answered
content:
**What is the earnings-volume discount?** A discount on the transfer fee of a transfer to one of the host's Payout Methods. The transfer fee's earnings-volume discount is 25 percent when the earnings released to the method less than 6 whole months before the booking day total at least USD 75000.00, 10 percent when they total at least USD 30000.00 but less than USD 75000.00, and nothing below that.

**Which amounts are added up?** The earnings released to this method, by release date, on dates less than 6 whole months before the booking day, the day the transfer fee is booked on the method's ledger. Credits, returned transfers and earnings released to the host's other methods are not part of the total.

**Where do the bands start and end?**

| Earnings released to the method in the window | Earnings-volume discount |
|---|---|
| USD 75000.00 or more | 25 percent |
| USD 30000.00 to below USD 75000.00 | 10 percent |
| Below USD 30000.00 | Nothing |

**What about totals right on the lines?** With hypothetical totals:

| Total released in the window | Discount |
|---|---|
| USD 75000.00 | 25 percent |
| USD 74999.99 | 10 percent |
| USD 30000.00 | 10 percent |
| USD 29999.99 | Nothing |

**Does a release from exactly 6 months ago count?** No. With an imagined booking day of 2026-07-20, earnings released on 2026-01-20 are 6 whole months earlier and fall outside the window; earnings released on 2026-01-21 are counted.

**Is the discount a percentage or an amount?** A percentage of the transfer fee.
